# Data cleaning for CRM migration

*Client industry: B2B services | Completed: 2023-08-14 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p16*

## The problem
The client was a firm moving 120k messy contacts to a new CRM.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, dataframe-based data wrangling, hand-written analytical queries. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
